sources.snippet: Our model family starts from EfficientDet-D0, which has comparable accuracy as YOLOv3. Then we scale up this baseline model using our compound scaling method to obtain a list of detection models EfficientDet-D1 to D6, with different trade-offs between accuracy and model complexity. ** For simplicity, we compare the whole detectors here.
